text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 古风雅致 · 临水书斋 · 纯环境.
Environment: An empty fictional classical Chinese garden study, warm pale elm joinery, delicate lattice windows, cream lime plaster, linen drape, low writing desk, ceramic tea set, unfurled blank paper, open view to a small lotus pond and pale stone bridge. Refined ivory and muted celadon palette, bright diffuse morning. Cinematic physical set photography, no dynastic accuracy claim, no red-gold palace spectacle. Original cinematic location photography for an intimate romance story. Vicky's aesthetic: bright high-key but retained highlight texture; cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown with restrained muted accent color; soft broad frontal/window fill, gentle low-contrast shadows; tactile plaster, wood, linen, glass and stone; very subtle film halation and grain, clean luminous air. Lived-in details without clutter, beautiful but plausible real location rather than showroom CGI. 35-50mm natural perspective, midground environment clearly legible with gently softer far depth. Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Use case: spatial production design. Create 建筑图 for 古风雅致 · 临水书斋 · 纯环境. Image 1 is the geometric source of truth. Image 2 is original material and style reference. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Keep the plan footprint, doors, windows, fixed landmarks and circulation exactly consistent. Concept reconstruction, not measured construction. Match original color palette and rendering style, detailed legible clean image, landscape. NO people, animals, silhouettes or figures on posters. No fake measurements, no watermarks.
